title: National Trends in Opioid Prescription Spending Among Medicaid and Medicare Part D Recipients from 2018 to 2022
content: Opioid-related deaths in the U.S. have surged, despite ongoing policy efforts. This cross-sectional study analyzed trends in opioid spending among Medicaid and Medicare Part D beneficiaries from 2018 to 2022. Overall, opioid prescriptions and total spending declined, though patterns varied by drug. Findings suggest recent interventions may be reducing opioid reliance.
